warning: Seed values transcribed from public provider docs on 2026-10-25. They are inputs to be re-verified by the registry probe job, not constants. Prices per token are deliberately absent: the price table is a separate versioned artifact. Match rule: within a provider, the first entry in file order whose model_match glob matches wins; '*' is the fallback.

caching.disable_method: prompt_cache_options.mode=explicit with no prompt_cache_breakpoint => no cache read/write
caching.isolation: prompt_cache_key can separate cache accounting per customer; treat as accounting, not as a security boundary
caching.notes: Read multiplier differs on some models (docs list 0.05x for one model). Resolve per model from the price table.
No cache-write surcharge on these models. Minimum length varies with tools/images/schemas; cached_tokens rounded down to multiples of 128. A0 arm not runnable: baseline is RAW with automatic caching.

caching.disable_method: omit cache_control (no top-level automatic caching, no block breakpoints)
caching.explicit_method: cache_control {type: ephemeral[, ttl]} on blocks, or top-level automatic caching
caching.isolation: isolated per organization; per workspace on Claude API (org-level only on some cloud platforms)
caching.notes: Read multiplier is lower on some current models (0.05x / 0.025x per docs). Prompts below minimum are silently uncached: check both usage fields = 0. Longer TTL entries must precede shorter ones.

caching.explicit_method: cached content objects via generateContent API (not Interactions API)
caching.notes: Implicit discount is not guaranteed (applies only on hit). Min tokens 2048 (2.5) / 4096 (3.x listed models). Explicit cache storage pricing and TTL not stated on the page: take from price table.

Multi-turn: previous request cached only if the new request adds >= 2050 tokens; small deltas reprocess the last 2050 tokens at full rate. Planner must batch small tool results into >= 2050-token turns or accept no cache.
